died.name: Cicero
died.cause: facing an assassin sent by an enemy
died.last_words: I go no further: approach, veteran soldier, and, if you can at least do so much properly, sever this neck. [...] What would you have done had you come to me as your first victim?

died.name: Algernon Sidney
died.cause: prior to execution by beheading for treason
died.last_words: I know that my Redeemer liveth. I die for the good old cause.

died.name: Michel Ney
died.cause: When executed by firing squad, he refused to wear a blindfold and was allowed the right to give the order to fire himself
died.last_words: Soldiers, when I give the command to fire, fire straight at my heart. Wait for the order. It will be my last to you. I protest against my condemnation. I have fought a hundred battles for France, and not one against her ... Soldiers, fire!

died.name: Edward Irving
died.last_words: If I die, I die unto the Lord. Amen.

died.name: Herbert C. Jones
died.desc: United States Navy officer and Medal of Honor recipient
died.cause: mortally wounded aboard USS California (BB-44) during the attack on Pearl Harbor
died.last_words: Leave me alone! I am done for. Get out of here before the magazines go off.

died.name: Robert R. Scott
died.desc: United States Navy sailor and Medal of Honor recipient
died.cause: refusing to evacuate flooded air compressor compartment aboard USS California (BB-44) during the attack on Pearl Harbor
died.last_words: As long as I can give these people air, I'm sticking.

died.name: Darby Crash
died.cause: writing a note to his friend David "Bosco" Davenport while dying of a heroin overdose
died.last_words: My life, my leather, my love goes to Bosco.

born.name: Columba
born.last_words: Here must I stop. What follows, let Baithen write.

born.name: William Barton Rogers
born.desc: founder and first president of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

born.name: Hedley Vicars
born.cause: killed in action in the Crimean War

born.name: Walter Nowotny
born.desc: Second World War German fighter ace
born.cause: crashing due to engine failure after combat with United States Army Air Force planes
